name: computer-use-linux
description: Native Linux desktop control: semantic AT-SPI accessibility trees, screenshots, compositor window targeting (GNOME, KDE, Hyprland, niri, COSMIC, i3, X11), Wayland/X11 input, and an on-screen activity indicator.

interface.shortDescription: Control Linux desktop apps with semantic accessibility trees, screenshots, and native input.
interface.longDescription: Inspect and control local Linux applications through AT-SPI accessibility trees, desktop portals, compositor-aware window targeting (GNOME, KDE, Hyprland, niri, COSMIC, i3, and X11), single-round-trip post-action capture, and a click-through on-screen activity indicator. Screenshots and accessibility trees can contain private data, and input reaches real applications.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Linux Computer Use is ready
